title: ptarmica ptarmicoides
intro: Ptarmica ptarmicoides, commonly known as Boneset, is a perennial plant native to North America, characterized by its tall stems and clusters of white or pink flowers. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate pain and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Boneset include its ability to relieve muscle spasms, reduce swelling, and support the immune system, making it a popular remedy for colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of Boneset include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
